description: Return the indexed full text of an attachment. Passing a regular item key works too: its attachments are searched and the first one with indexed text is used. Text comes from Zotero's own index, so it is available only for attachments Zotero has indexed. Long documents can be truncated with maxCharacters.

groupId.description: Group library ID. Omit for the personal library ("My Library"), which is what almost every request wants. Group IDs come from zotero_list_libraries.

itemKey.description: Attachment key, or a parent item key to search its attachments.

maxCharacters.description: Truncate the returned text at this many characters.

name: zotero_get_item_fulltext
title: Get attachment full text
